rationale: Fault onset at ~0.011 s (V crossing 0.9 pu). Ride-through: resource stays connected at all samples and voltage stays above the staircase envelope minimum at each fault-relative time (0.2 pu through 0.15 s, 0.5 pu through 0.7 s, 0.85 pu through 2.0 s). Reactive support: after the 0.1 s response deadline, the only sample with V < 0.9 pu is t = 0.12 s where iq = 0.25 pu >= 0.2 pu required.
